map.→ 打开包装盒展开面积工具: -> Open the box dieline area tool
map.三种盒型的展开面积差在哪？: How do the dieline areas of the three box types differ?
map.以「长方体盒 长300×宽200×高100 mm、粘口30 mm、出血3 mm」: Take "rectangular box 300 x 200 x 100 mm, glue flap 30 mm, bleed 3 mm" as an example
map.出血和粘口为什么计入用纸？: Why are the bleed and the glue flap counted in the paper?
map.出血是裁切安全边（通常 3 mm），避免裁偏露白；粘口是成型时涂胶搭接区，虽被遮: The bleed is the cutting safety margin (usually 3 mm) that keeps an offcut from exposing white; the glue flap is the glued overlap when the box is formed, hidden but still consuming board. The quote should be based on the net board size including the bleed, not only the geometric surface area, otherwise the paper usage is underestimated by 5%-10%.
map.刀模设计时确认纸板净尺寸（长×宽），给拼版与裁切留足粘口与出血余量。: When designing the die line, confirm the net board size (length x width) and leave enough margin for the glue flap, the bleed and the cutting layout.
map.印刷报价前核算包装盒展开用纸面积，结合纸张规格估算单只成本与每千只用纸量。: Before asking for a printing quote, work out the dieline area of the box, and combine it with the paper specification to estimate the cost per box and the paper used per thousand boxes.
map.对比不同盒型（长方体盒/插边盒/托盘盒）的用纸差异，在满足结构强度下选省料方案。: Compare the paper use of different box types (regular slotted carton / tuck end / tray) and pick the leanest option that still meets the structural strength.
map.输入长方体包装盒的长、宽、高，工具按表面积公式 2×(L×W+L×H+W×H): Enter the length, width and height of a rectangular box; the tool computes the total dieline area from 2×(L×W+L×H+W×H) and can convert it into the number of sheets, which helps with printing quotes and carton material accounting.
map.长方体盒(rect)侧壁环绕+两端+粘口；插边盒(tuck)多一块翻盖、展开长边: A rectangular box (rect) has the side walls plus both ends plus the glue flap; a tuck end box (tuck) adds a lid flap so the long side of the dieline is longer; a tray box (tray) has only a bottom, low walls and dust flaps, using the least paper. This tool applies the formula for the box type you choose; the more complex the box and the more flaps, the larger the dieline area.
map.：长方体表面积=2×(300×200+300×100+200×100)=2200: : the surface area of the box = 2×(300x200+300x100+200x100)=220000 mm²=2200 cm². The dieline area = side band 2×(300+200)×100=100000 + both ends 2×300x200=120000 + glue flap 30×(2x100+2x200)=18000, totalling 238000 mm²=2380 cm². The net board size = ((300+200)x2+30)×(100+200+30)=1030×330 mm, and 1036×336 mm with the bleed. The total area including the bleed = (238000+(1030+330)×2×3)/100=2461.6 cm², so the paper per 1000 boxes = 2461.6x1000/10000≈246.16 m².
